[Read customer stories](https://www.matillion.com/success-stories) [![Group 206](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/images/Group-206.png)](https://www.matillion.com/technology-partners/snowflake)[![Group 63](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/images/Group-63.png)](https://www.matillion.com/success-stories/cisco)[![Group 62](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/images/Group-62.png)](https://www.matillion.com/success-stories/juniper-networks)[![Group 73](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/images/Group-73.png)](https://www.matillion.com/success-stories/tui) ## Frequently asked **questions** ##### What is a Matillion Credit? Matillion Credits are used to pay for the consumption of Matillion Products. A Credit is the smallest unit of charge, consumed when a customer uses a Matillion resource. ##### How do I get started? Unlock the power of your data and accelerate your journey to AI and analytics-ready insights with Matillion Data Productivity Cloud. [**Start a free trial here**](https://app.matillion.com/register). ##### How do I know how many credits I am using? You can monitor your Matillion credit usage at any time. Should you need to purchase additional credits, contact us and we will guide you through the process. ##### How are credits consumed by the Data Productivity Cloud? Credits are consumed by: - Task Hours. Tasks are created whenever an operation is performed by Matillion. As a pipeline is executed, the main "Run" task is broken down into more granular tasks as the execution continues. Task hours are the combined execution time for each task across Matillion. Task hours are only charged when running a pipeline. Operations such as validation or sampling are not billed. - Developer users - any additional Developer Users outside of your included Developer Users. ##### Can I use multiple editions? An Edition (Developer, Teams or Scale) is tied to a subscription and applies to all products used within that subscription. A Data Productivity Cloud account can have only one active subscription at a given time, which means it can use only one Edition. If you need multiple editions, you can create additional Data Productivity Cloud accounts and purchase separate subscriptions with the desired edition. ##### What cloud marketplaces are supported? You can contract directly with Matillion or pay through your AWS, Azure or Snowflake account. ## Focus on **your data** Matillion's credit-based pricing aligns cost with the value you create. Choose from Developer, Teams, and Scale editions with transparent consumption tracking that grows alongside your data operations. ![](https://www.matillion.com/assets/img/text-block-blue-hex.png)![](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/icons/Trending-Up-Streamline-Feather.svg) #### Value-aligned consumption Pay only for pipeline execution time and active capacity. Credits consume based on actual task hours — orchestration, transformation, and streaming work that delivers business value. ![](https://www.matillion.com/assets/img/text-block-blue-hex.png)![](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/icons/Search-Dollar-Streamline-Plump-Remix.svg) #### Transparent and predictable Fixed annual packages with included credits provide cost predictability, while our consumption tracking dashboard will give you full visibility of how many credits you are using. ![](https://www.matillion.com/assets/img/text-block-blue-hex.png)![](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/icons/Star-Square-Streamline-Flex-Neon.svg) #### Enterprise grade Scale edition unlocks enterprise features like custom SSO, hybrid deployment, and data lineage, with Premium Support available as an add-on. #### Subscribe via your cloud marketplace Consolidate billing and manage subscriptions in one place - [![aws logo](https://www.matillion.com/assets/img/aws-logo.png)](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-4bgvutjemdafu?sr=0-1&ref_=beagle&applicationId=AWSMPContessa) - [![azure logo](https://www.matillion.com/assets/img/azure-logo.png)](https://azuremarketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/apps/matillion.matillion-etl-billing?tab=overview) - [![snowflake logo](https://www.matillion.com/assets/img/snowflake-marketplace-logo.png)](https://app.snowflake.com/marketplace/listing/GZSYZ10SV6W/matillion-matillion-data-productivity-cloud) ## Ready to get moving?
